# Per-frame steps of GF7E01, scaled by the step scale: 0.5 at 120 fps (SFASSAULT_FPS=120,
# src/frame_rate.cpp), 1 otherwise, where they compute exactly what the game does.
# "ADDR OPERAND": the instruction at ADDR, whose OPERAND carries the value from the previous
# frame (gcn-recomp docs/diagnostics.md, "Finding a game's per-frame steps").
#
# PARTIAL: this covers mission 1's space flight only, and not all of it; the mission's
# script still runs at twice its speed. See docs/dev/frame-rate.md.
#
# How these were chosen: tools/find_steps.py lists every load, scalable op and store back
# to the same address; GCN_STORE_HIST over the same 70 s of virtual time in the flight
# (fortuna route) at 60 and at 120 fps keeps the sites that ran on 30 frames in a row at 60
# and ran about twice as often at 120 (frame-driven, not time-driven), outside the SDK.
# Integer steps only where they ran at most once a frame; four of those hang the game when
# taken every other frame and are listed at the end, commented out.
# Comments: the op, its store's runs and streak over 4196 frames at 60, its runs at 120.

# Not steps: never scale these.
# - Integer increments that hang the mission at 120 fps when taken every other frame
#   (found by bisecting with GCN_STEP_SKIP): 800D7CAC 800D7E30 8016B73C 8018967C
# - The SDK (0x8012D438-0x8015B000, and from 0x801E8D48): the VI retrace count at 8013FC14,
#   taken every other frame, leaves VIWaitForRetrace waiting forever.
# - Time-driven sites (as many runs a second at 120 as at 60; the sound library and timers):
#   80012E48 80012E68 80023F0C 80023F24 80023F2C 80023F34 80023F4C 80023F5C
#   80027F04 80027F44 80027F54 80027F64 80052760 800529B4 800DE9E0 800DEA08
#   800FA104 8010B168 8010B1E4 80122820 80122DBC 80122DDC 80122DFC 8016A840
#   8016B050 8018BA24 8018BC6C 8018C638 8018CC50
